positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Search Quality Team
positions.description:
- Directly responsible for creating and executing a roadmap to increase the health and efficiency of Yelp's consumer services marketplace using data and machine learning
- Lead multiple projects with C-level visibly resulting in both +𝘅% 𝗮𝗻𝗱 +𝘅𝘅% 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰 𝘄𝗶𝗻𝘀
- Drive and own business results through collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders (Engineering, Product, Sales / Marketing)

positions.title: Software Engineer - Search Quality Team
positions.description:
- Promoted twice in 18 months. One of fastest in company history
- First new grad to be offered both PM and SWE roles
- Started and led year-long rewrite of review snippets system leading to multiple +𝘅% 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰 𝘄𝗶𝗻𝘀. Replaced legacy heuristic system with transformer based system
- Championed design of new top level company experiment / success metric 
- Made ranking and recall changes to support multiple PR initiatives (example linked below)

Technologies used:
- Spark
- Java (Dropwizard)
- Python (Pyramid)
- Numpy / Pandas 
- Tensorflow
- AWS
- Redshift
